facts.business: Kokuyo Camlin Limited is one of India's most established manufacturers of stationery and art materials, offering a diverse portfolio of over 2,000 SKUs across writing instruments, scholastic stationery, art materials, hobby and craft products, and office supplies under brands like Camel and Camlin.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to loss of Rs 2,356.81 lakhs recognized in year ended 31 March 2025 representing shortage of physical inventory (Rs 1,032.44 lakhs in cost of material consumed including indirect taxes Rs 212.52 lakhs and Rs 1,324.37 lakhs in changes in inventories). Management had not identified possible impact on prior period's financial information, no adjustment made to comparative figures. Current year opinion also modified due to possible effect on comparability.

key_risks: Revenue overstatement risk throughout the year and at year-end to achieve performance targets
Risk of revenue overstatement through incorrect estimation of discounts, incentives and rebates
Inventory shortage risk as evidenced by physical inventory shortage of Rs 2,356.81 lakhs in prior year
